title: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
commons_title: File:It Came Upon a Midnight Clear - Singing Sergeants - United States Air Force Band.mp3
composition: words by Edmund Sears (1849), music by Richard Storrs Willis (1850); both public domain
credit: Arrangement and performance by the United States Air Force Band (a work of the US Government, public domain).
lyrics: It came upon the midnight clear
From angels bending near the earth
To touch their harps of gold
Peace on the earth, goodwill to men
The world in solemn stillness lay
